args:
exec /opt/phase7-native/entrypoint-phase7-watchdog.sh &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" || true' TERM INT
while [ ! -e /phase7-shared/finished ]; do
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || { wait "$pid"; exit 1; }
  sleep 0.2
done
kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$pid" || true
containers.name: simulator

args:
while [ ! -e /phase7-shared/operator-policy-passed ] &&
      [ ! -e /phase7-shared/operator-policy-failed ]; do
  sleep 0.2
done
if [ -e /phase7-shared/operator-policy-passed ]; then
  set +e
  source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
  export ROS_LOG_DIR=/tmp/phase7-verifier-logs
  mkdir -p "$ROS_LOG_DIR"
  python3 /opt/phase7-runtime/verify_phase7_live_nav2_cancel.py \
    --require-live-sam3-adapter \
    --require-enabled-prompt-transitions \
    --output /phase7-shared/result.json
  code=$?
  touch /phase7-shared/finished
  exit "$code"
fi
touch /phase7-shared/finished
exit 1
containers.name: verify-live-nav2-cancel
